name: hash-blake3
algorithm: std BLAKE3, 32-byte output over splitmix64 bytes, reps passes with a one-byte write-back (mk/hash-blake3.mk).

skip.c: no std hash: C has no standard BLAKE3, 32-byte output
skip.rust: no std BLAKE3, 32-byte output: Rust std has none (only SipHash-1-3 in DefaultHasher); no crate stands in
skip.go: no std BLAKE3, 32-byte output: Go std has none (hash/maphash is a different, seeded hash); no module stands in

notes: Idiomatic standard library: one call of each language's std function per pass (plan/06-m6.md 4.1). Bytes per second = mib * 1048576 * reps / median.
Zig: std.crypto.hash.Blake3 hashes several chunks at once in @Vector lanes; Mk is one chunk at a time, scalar.

Checksums: Mk (mk build -release), Zig 0.17.0 (-O ReleaseFast -mcpu=x86_64_v2) and, where it has the function, Go 1.27.3 (GOAMD64=v2) printed the same values for args and quick on the owner's machine, 2026-11-06 (std-hashmod session 1). The publish-size checksum was re-agreed by every column in `go run ./tools/bench verify -publish-size` on the owner's machine, 2026-11-07 (std-hashmod session 5, after the reps were raised). Not published: no number here is a measurement.
